name: ethora
description: Build and run chat apps, messaging rooms and AI agents on Ethora from ChatGPT: create an app, open rooms, add users, create agents with a knowledge base, put a chat widget on a website.

interface.longDescription:
Ethora is an open-source chat and messaging platform with a built-in AI agent framework. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Ethora account so you can build and run chat products by describing them.

What you can do:
- Create a chat app (your own tenant with users, rooms and branding) and open chat rooms.
- Create AI agents with a persona and a knowledge base from a website or uploaded documents, put them in rooms, and talk to them.
- Seed a room with several agents that reply to people and to each other.
- Generate the <script> tag that puts an AI chat widget on any website.
- Send and read messages, search message history, manage users and files.

Who it is for: product teams and developers adding chat or AI assistants to a website or app, and anyone who wants a working chat space with AI participants without setting up infrastructure.

How it works: you sign in with your Ethora account (or create one in the conversation). Tools act only on apps you own. A compact core tool set is listed by default; more tools are enabled on request within the conversation.

Limitations: the plugin manages apps, rooms, users and agents. It does not render chat inside ChatGPT; people chat in the Ethora web client, your app via the chat component, or the website widget. Webhooks, push-notification setup, moderation actions and billing are managed in the Ethora dashboard, not through the plugin. Wallet and crypto features are not available in the hosted server.
capabilities: Create a chat app with rooms and users
Create AI agents with a persona and a knowledge base
Put several AI agents in one room that talk to people and each other
Generate a chat widget embed for any website
Send and read messages, search chat history
Crawl a website or upload documents as agent knowledge
Manage API keys and app tokens for integrations
defaultPrompt: Create an Ethora app called Support Desk with a room and an AI agent that answers from our docs.
Put a chat widget on my website that answers questions about our product.
Set up a room with two AI agents who debate a topic with me.
